product.name: WE-T800 Multi-Function Field Monitor
product.description: Industrial field monitor with 4G connectivity, RS485 Modbus-RTU, two analog inputs (4–20 mA), two digital inputs, IP68 enclosure, and MQTT/HTTP/WEST cloud protocols.
product.lead: A sealed IP68 field unit for distributed monitoring: 4G backhaul, RS485 Modbus-RTU, two 4–20 mA analog channels, two digital inputs, and flexible power from internal Li-ion packs or 9–30 V DC. Built for water utilities, environmental sites, and industrial IoT where reliability matters.
product.og_description: IP68 4G field device: RS485, AI, DI, cloud protocols with MQTT/HTTP.

highlights.title: 4G & Cloud-ready
highlights.text: LTE FDD/TDD bands supported; MQTT, HTTP, and WEST cloud protocols; 3-year cellular data plan option (100 MB/month).

highlights.title: Field I/O
highlights.text: 1× RS485 (4800–115200 bps, Modbus-RTU), 2× AI (4–20 mA), 2× DI (switch or pulse counting), 2× configurable DC outputs (3.6 / 5 / 12 V).

highlights.title: Rugged & Readable
highlights.text: IP68 enclosure; 60×32 mm LCD with LED indicators and keypad for local readings and alarms.

highlights.title: Dual Power
highlights.text: Internal Li-ion options (114000 or 228000 mAh) with automatic handover to 9–30 V DC external supply.

highlights.title: Mobile Supervision
highlights.text: Bluetooth for local configuration; companion app for remote visibility.

highlights.title: Configurable Timing
highlights.text: Sampling and upload periods configurable from 10 s to 18 h to match battery life and network duty cycle.

specifications.label: Model
specifications.value: WE-T800 multi-function monitor / RTU-style field unit

specifications.label: Connectivity
specifications.value: 4G LTE; SMA female antenna; MQTT, HTTP, WEST cloud

specifications.label: Sensor Excitation
specifications.value: 2× DC output ports, 3.6 V / 5 V / 12 V selectable

specifications.label: Power — External
specifications.value: 9–30 V DC (typical 24 V), auto-changeover with battery

specifications.label: Local UI
specifications.value: 60×32 mm LCD, status LEDs, keypad, Bluetooth for provisioning

applications.title: Water & Environmental Networks
applications.text: Smart water and pipeline monitoring: consolidate analog, digital, and serial field devices into a single 4G-capable uplink.

applications.title: Energy & Industrial IoT
applications.text: Remote supervision for pumps, treatment skids, and distributed assets where Modbus-RTU sensors must be bridged to cloud SCADA or MQTT/HTTP endpoints.
